svg.title: Vectorlab
svg.desc: Vectorlab banner: two classes of activation points in a 3D residual-stream space with gridded walls, the arrow r from the mean of one class to the other, and a loop showing the two edits: ablation moves every point onto the plane perpendicular to r, and steering moves the negative class along r. The title Vectorlab is drawn with arrows.
svg.text: Find, inspect and edit behavior directions
extract → analyze → search → edit → eval → export
